def minrot(occ,counts):

 low=((full^occ)&-(full^occ)).bit_length()-1
 r,c=idx_to_coord[low]
 best=999; ways=0; bestpath=()
 for gi,bits,hh,ww in ps_by_start2.get((r,c),[]):
  if counts[gi] and not(occ&bits):
   nc=list(counts);nc[gi]-=1

   score=sub+rot
   if score<best:best=score;ways=nways;bestpath=((gi,r,c,bits,hh,ww),)+path
